subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vociferous
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word.
 
• The word **Vociferous(मुखर) **means expressing or characterized by strong feelings; loud and forceful
 
• The word **Silent **(चुपचाप)** **means not uttering any sound.
 
• The meaning of word **Vociferous **is opposite to the meaning of word **Silent**, *hence silent is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Sullen **means short tempered and moody (उदास).

Example : I am **sullen **quite often.

 
• the word **Gallant **means brave or heroic (वीर)

Example : She had made **gallant **efforts to gather herself.

 
• The word **Pugnacious **means eager to debate, quarrel, or argue (झगड़ालू)

Example : My brother is always **Pugnacious**.
